sn22.33:1.2: Yam bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ tam pajahatha ||
sn22.33:1.3: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || || 4
sn22.33:1.5: Rūpam bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ tam pajahatha ||
sn22.33:1.6: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || || 6
sn22.33:1.8: sā vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || || 7
sn22.33:1.11: te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti || || 9
sn22.33:1.13: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || || 10
sn22.33:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yam imasmiṃ Jetavane tiṇakaṭṭha-sākhā-palāsam taṃ jano hareyya vā ḍaheyya va yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya ||
sn22.33:2.3: Amhe jano harati vā ḍahati vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā karotīti || ||
sn22.33:2.6: Na hi no etam bhante attā vā attaniyaṃ vā ti || || 11
sn22.33:2.7: Evam eva kho bhikkhave rūpam na tumhākaṃ || tam pajahatha ||
sn22.33:2.8: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati ||
sn22.33:2.14: taṃ hi vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissatīti || || 1-2
